inputs.text: This is exactly how they manufacture the appearance of resistance: Phoenix leaders approve a restriction on ICE and other agencies using city property, then sell it as accountability. But the machinery stays in place; enforcement can simply be managed out of public view while the council vote on Wednesday night gives people a reassuring show. They’re not stopping the system—they’re controlling the optics.
